text:
maria-cs: Weekly acct-health check-in for AtlasPay — short thread. Key focus: hosted API spend vs commit, and a small anomaly the billing classifier just flagged.

olivia-fin: Quick numbers: commit = $50,000/mo. Current month burn (projected) = $61,200 if this week's pace holds. Month-to-date = $38,400. Forecasted overage ~22%.

billing-bot: ALERT: anomaly_detected atlaspay (acct_id: A-9843) — sustained streaming sessions exceed baseline. WoW token usage +28%. Median stream duration 900s (baseline 120s).

sam-eng: saw increased 5xx around 03:10 UTC yesterday for atlaspay routes. Correlated with long-lived streams + KV pressure. Latency p50 -> 160ms to 430ms during spike.

maria-cs: TL;DR: spend is trending above commit; anomaly is likely long streaming sessions. Need 1) a quick customer heads-up 2) set a near-term billing guard 3) investigate root cause & recommend config changes.

olivia-fin: Can we flip an 80% of commit billing alert for them and pause non-critical bursts? If they cross 100% we should trigger billing mitigation workflow.

sam-eng: Technical mitigation options: 
- enforce streaming max_duration (recommend 300s) on their SDK usage
- enable prefix KV cache TTL reductions for heavy sessions
- temporary rate-limit their API key (can do per-route)
I can prepare the quick-runbook.

tim-ops: we can add a soft quota at 85% that only notifies, and a hard throttle rule at 110% if billing team signs off. Need AM approval for any service-impacting throttle.

jason-am: I'll reach out to AtlasPay now — quick note: mention we've observed unusual long-running streams that are driving spend and ask if they introduced any bulk/diagnostic job. Offering a 30-day review session and a one-time credit is OK by me.

maria-cs: Action items captured: 
- @jason-am to message AtlasPay with initial check and ask for any recent rollout (J: pinged them)
- @sam-eng to draft runbook for streaming controls + config snippets
- @olivia-fin to enable 80% billing alert and propose buffer credit option
- @tim-ops to prepare soft quota rule (85%) and outline throttle triggers
- billing-bot to keep monitoring and escalate if another +15% WoW jump

deploy-bot: Created ticket TKT-2345: "AtlasPay spend drift + streaming anomaly" assigned to sam-eng, tim-ops, olivia-fin.

maria-cs: I'll post a short enablement doc for AtlasPay with recommended SDK settings and a short checklist before the sync. Planning a 30-min call tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

olivia-fin: noted. If they accept the credit + tuning call, we can avoid touching their prod throughput.

sam-eng: I put a draft snippet in the internal gist: 
```
// recommended client-side guard
const MAX_STREAM_MS = 300000; // 300s
client.createStream({ maxDurationMs: MAX_STREAM_MS });
```

maria-cs: thanks all. I'll update thread after AM convo. :white_check_mark:

jason-am: replied to customer — they had a nightly diagnostic that started last week. Asking them to postpone until we align.

maria-cs: perfect, keep me posted.

olivia-fin: will toggle the 80% alert now and confirm once live.

billing-bot: monitoring_enabled for acct A-9843 at thresholds [80%, 100%]. Will post if threshold breached.

sam-eng: runbook PR ready, linking in ticket.

maria-cs: closing this check-in — follow-ups in TKT-2345 and the call notes. Thanks team. :v:
